basic_details.job_title: Punjabi University Project Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Pharmaceutical Sciences and Drug Research, Punjabi University, Patiala, has invited applications for two (2) Project Fellows in a RUSA-2 sponsored research project on compounds for combating Alzheimer's disease. The stipend is Rs. 25,000 per month (consolidated), the post lasts till 31/01/2027, and the essential qualification is M.Pharm in Pharmaceutical Chemistry with First Class Division. Applications go by email to [email protected] within 10 days of the advertisement dated 20/11/26, which works out to about 30 November 2026 (10 days from 20 November 2026).

how_to_apply: Eligible candidates may send their applications to Dr. Yogita Bansal (Principal Investigator) by email at [email protected] within 10 days of the advertisement dated 20/11/26. The notice invites fresh applications supported by detailed biodata along with attested copies of certificates.

Fill the "Application Format for Project Fellow For RUSA-Phase II project" printed on page 2 of the notice: name in full block letters, parent's/spouse's name, sex, nationality, marital status, date of birth, age, address for communication, contact number and email.
Paste a self-attested photograph in the box on the form.
Enter educational qualifications from 10th onwards, highest qualification first, with exam passed, board/university, year of passing, percentage of marks and awards or achievements.
State whether you are GPAT/GATE/NET qualified and list your experience, current occupation first, with post, nature of employment, dates of joining and leaving and total period.
Sign the declaration with place and date.
Email the form with your detailed biodata and attested copies of certificates to [email protected].
Application in the prescribed format with a self-attested photo
Attested photocopies of educational qualifications (10th onwards)
Additional information, if any, on separate sheets
important_instructions: Only fresh applications are invited. An incomplete form, or one without supporting documents, will not be entertained. Experience of a complete year only will be counted. If any information is found false or incorrect at any stage, the candidature or appointment is liable to cancellation or termination without notice or any compensation.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The application format asks candidates to state whether they are GPAT/GATE/NET qualified (Yes/No) and to list experience with the current occupation first; experience of a complete year will be counted. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

rows.essential_qualification: M.Pharm in Pharmaceutical Chemistry with First Class Division
rows.desirable: Experience in molecular modelling, synthetic chemistry, and/or animal handling

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Each Project Fellow gets a stipend of Rs. 25,000/- per month, which the notice describes as consolidated. The appointment is for the duration of the project till 31/01/2027; if applicable, an extension may be given as per RUSA-2 norms.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Punjabi University Project Fellows
content_sections.text: Fill the "Application Format for Project Fellow For RUSA-Phase II project" printed on page 2 of the notice: name in full block letters, parent's/spouse's name, sex, nationality, marital status, date of birth, age, address for communication, contact number and email. Paste a self-attested photograph in the box on the form. Enter educational qualifications from 10th onwards, highest qualification first, with exam passed, board/university, year of passing, percentage of marks and awards or achievements. State whether you are GPAT/GATE/NET qualified and list your experience, current occupation first, with post, nature of employment, dates of joining and leaving and total period. Sign the declaration with place and date. Email the form with your detailed biodata and attested copies of certificates to [email protected] . Application in the prescribed format with a self-attested photo Detailed biodata Attested copies of certificates Attested photocopies of educational qualifications (10th onwards) Additional information, if any, on separate sheets

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The notice refers to an interview for candidates who are shortlisted. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only fresh applications are invited. An incomplete form, or one without supporting documents, will not be entertained. Experience of a complete year only will be counted. If any information is found false or incorrect at any stage, the candidature or appointment is liable to cancellation or termination without notice or any compensation.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Punjabi University Project Fellow Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are two (2) Project Fellow posts in the RUSA-2 sponsored research project in the Department of Pharmaceutical Sciences and Drug Research.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Punjabi University Project Fellow posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent within 10 days of the advertisement dated 20/11/26, which is about 30 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Project Fellow post?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is M.Pharm in Pharmaceutical Chemistry with First Class Division; experience in molecular modelling, synthetic chemistry, and/or animal handling is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the stipend for a Punjabi University Project Fellow?
faq.answer: The stipend is Rs. 25,000/- per month (consolidated).

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the Punjabi University Project Fellow posts?
faq.answer: Email the filled application format with detailed biodata and attested copies of certificates to Dr. Yogita Bansal (Principal Investigator) at [email protected].

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Fellow posts?
faq.answer: The notice refers to an interview for shortlisted candidates, and no TA/DA will be given for attending it.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the Project Fellow appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment lasts till 31/01/2027; if applicable, an extension may be given as per RUSA-2 norms.

faq.question: Q8. On which research project will the Project Fellows work?
faq.answer: They will work on the RUSA-2 project "In Silico assisted design, Synthesis and Evaluation of multifunctional compounds for combating Alzheimer's disease" under Dr Yogita Bansal.

faq.question: Q9. Will an incomplete application be accepted?
faq.answer: No, an incomplete form or one without supporting documents will not be entertained.
